original_dataset.access: Existing Hugging Face account access; documentation only

method.protocol: HTTPS byte-range GET requests with Range header
method.refused_responses: Any status other than 206 or mismatched Content-Range; body is closed before a full-file read

transfer.preliminary_failed_train_probe: Small projected-column read; exact transfer not retained. Excluded from production total.
transfer.api_and_documentation_bytes: Small API listings/documentation requests; not metered
transfer.note: Production total is exact for successful cached extraction reads; it is not an exact whole-session network counter.

coverage_limit: Mirror source names/formulas and multiplicities match official aggregate counts; no row-by-row comparison to original archives or energy-label equivalence is claimed.
local_cache: JSON expansion is larger than network transfer; file mtimes record cache writes, not exact network-request timestamps.
